title: Investor input
description: Request to screen one founder (POST /v1/screenings). Everything is optional except a founder identifier. Investor field values take precedence over the agent's findings.

client_ref.description: Optional ID the client uses to match responses (e.g. a CSV row number).

founding_date.description: The company's founding date: research uses only information from before it. If omitted, the agent looks it up; if it can't, the screening date is used and the memo says so.

fields.description: Template fields the investor knows. Values follow the template's allowed values. A missing field means 'not provided'; 'unknown' means the same.

voice_fields.description: Keys of the fields above that came from a voice note. They get provenance 'investor_voice'.

notes.description: Free-text investor notes (traction, gut feel, meeting notes). Shown in the memo only and never sent to the model.

policy.description: Controls for the memo's initial verdict. The client can recompute the verdict for other controls without a new request.

research.description: Run the web research agent. False uses only the investor's fields.

max_searches.description: Cap on web searches for this founder (cost control).

use_demo_cache.description: Reuse cached research and answers for known demo founders.
